$comment: The pinned Chrome for Testing build the managed browser installs (docs/design/remote-and-browser-completion.md §2.1). Version, URL, byte count and sha256 are compiled into the Runtime; nothing here is ever fetched at runtime, and there is no 'latest'. Chrome for Testing publishes no digests of its own — the JSON endpoints carry only a version and a URL, there is no sibling .sha256, and the storage layer's x-goog-hash comes from the same host as the bytes — so every sha256 here was observed by downloading the archive once and hashing it, with `node tools/browser-manifest.mjs` on that platform. Only macos-arm64 has been pinned that way; the other targets are absent rather than guessed, and on those platforms the Runtime pins the digest on first download instead (trust on first use, apps/runtime/src/browser/launch/managed.rs). Re-run the script per platform to add an entry, and note that one manifest pins one version: bumping `version` invalidates every URL in it.

macos-arm64.executable: chrome-mac-arm64/Google Chrome for Testing.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome for Testing
